parsed.rationale: I can't call this ECG normal: the QRS is wide (about 120 ms or more), V1–V2 show an rsR′ (M-shaped) pattern with secondary T-wave inversion, and I and V5–V6 have broad slurred S waves, which fits a complete right bundle branch block, and no lead shows ST elevation that meets STEMI criteria.
